newsitem.title: CANADA: Co-Steel to issue C$125 mln of debentures.
newsitem.headline: Co-Steel to issue C$125 mln of debentures.

text.p: Co-Steel Inc said on Friday it agreed with underwriters led by ScotiaMcLeod Inc and Gordon Capital Corp to issue C$125 million worth of 6.5 percent convertible subordinated debentures on a bought deal basis.
The steelmaker said the conversion price would be C$26.25 per common share, being a conversion ratio of 38.0952 common shares per C$1,000 principal amount of debentures.
Co-Steel said the underwriter group was also granted an option to purchase an additional C$10 million of convertible subordinated debentures, which expires on April 17, 1997.
Completion of the offer is subject to normal conditions of closing, including obtaining all requisite regulatory approvals.
Co-Steel said net proceeds of the offer would be used to finance capital expenditures at the company's steel-making operations and potential acquisitions in the steel and metals recycling business.
